errorCodes.meaning: No registered election with this identifier exists for this community, or the signer may not see it (CONVENTIONS §7) — including, for an election whose credential roll names a member party, a signer who has not proven in this request its membership of that party (Conformance item 3, VTI-VOT-017). Answered identically, so the task is no existence oracle.

Tickets are not being issued for the election: registration has not opened, voting has closed, the election is being closed or was cancelled, or the ballot box has not yet registered it (VTI-VOT-024).
`manifestDigest` is not the digest of the election's registered manifest. The requester read another manifest than the one the election runs under.
The election's roll rule does not admit the signer as the community's records stand now (VTI-VOT-021).

The community has already issued the signer a ticket for this election, in answer to a different request (VTI-VOT-022). A resend of the request it answered is answered with that answer, never with this code.
`request.label` is not `voter/<electionId>` for this election, or the blinded request does not verify under the community's voting parameters.

The election's roll rule is `credential` and the request carries no `presentation`. Under a credential roll eligibility is proven only by presenting the membership credential the roll names (VTI-VOT-025). Answered only to a signer who may see the election without a presentation (Conformance item 3); for a member-party election, any other signer is answered `electionUnknown`.

The presentation does not prove a membership credential for the party `roll.memberOf` names, held by the signer, valid now (VTI-VOT-025 items 1 to 3). `details.reason` says which check failed. Answered only to a signer who may see the election without a presentation (Conformance item 3); for a member-party election, any other signer is answered `electionUnknown`.

The presented membership credential, or an authorization credential its issuer's authority rests on, is revoked or suspended as its status shows now (VTI-VOT-025 item 4, VTI-CRD-011). Answered only to a signer who may see the election without a presentation (Conformance item 3); for a member-party election, any other signer is answered `electionUnknown`.

`roll.memberOf` is no longer a party the community trusts for the roll (VTI-VOT-026): it names a group the community no longer holds, or a member party whose own membership of the community has since expired, been suspended, been removed or had its membership credential revoked. No ticket is issued under it. Answered only to a signer who may see the election without a presentation (Conformance item 3); for a member-party election, any other signer is answered `electionUnknown`.

DigestMultibase.description:
A cryptographic digest as a multibase-encoded multihash — the encoding the W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0 defines for `digestMultibase`, and the one `did:webvh` uses for its SCID and entry hashes.

Multihash carries the hash algorithm in-band, so the value is self-describing and the wire format survives an algorithm change without a schema revision; multibase does the same for the base encoding, so a verifier never infers base58 from base64url by context. A bare hex string or a `sha-256:`-style prefix hard-codes one algorithm into the wire contract and is non-conforming here.

This definition constrains the *encoding only*. What the digest is computed over is stated by each referencing field, because it differs legitimately: a digest over a JSON document is taken over its RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization, while a digest over an opaque artifact is taken over its bytes. A field whose input is a JSON document and which does not name a canonicalization is not reproducible.

Restricted to the two multibase headers W3C Controlled Identifiers 1.0 §2.4 normatively requires — `z` (base58btc) and `u` (base64url-no-pad). CID permits others but states that "interoperability is not guaranteed between implementations using such values", and a registry whose purpose is interoperability should not mint digests a conforming verifier may be unable to read. The alphabets are enforced rather than assumed: base58btc excludes 0, O, I and l, and an earlier permissive pattern let three published examples carry digests that were not valid base58 at all. base58btc is RECOMMENDED, for consistency with `did:key` and `did:webvh`.

schema.description: An eligible party asks the community to blind-issue its ticket for one election: the community checks eligibility against its own records and signs a commitment it cannot open, so the ticket its voter's agent unblinds is one the community has never seen. Under a credential roll the party also presents its membership credential for the party the roll names, which the community checks at that moment. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

manifestDigest.description: The digest of the manifest the requester read (vtc/elections/show) and its agent bound the request to. A ticket is only ever asked for under the manifest the voter saw.

anyOf.description: A W3C Verifiable Presentation whose `nonce` is this document's `id` and whose `domain` is the community's DID, both signed by its holder's Data Integrity proof.
A compact presentation: an SD-JWT with a key-binding JWT whose `nonce` is this document's `id` and `aud` the community's DID.

presentation.description: Under a `credential` roll (voting/_shared/0.4 `RollRule`), and only then: the requester's presentation of its membership credential for the party `roll.memberOf` names, made by the credential's subject — who signs this document — and bound to this document (VTI-VOT-025). Required when the election's roll rule is `credential`, refused under any other rule. The community verifies it before, and without reference to, the election the request names, so an outage of a status list or a verification method it depends on is answered `indeterminate` whatever the election; it checks it as it stands at the moment of issuance and discards it once it has decided.
